rv.q: That simple scenic design—combined with a creatively structured script and superb performances by four actors playing 20 roles—creates magic on a small stage.
A real thinker of a play, it carries us expertly through wonder and connection without prescribing a fixed reality.
There is so much to love about this production. The directorial vision Palmer lays out and the impacting performances by the ensemble are both palpable and powerful.
If, however, you would like to be ‘challenged, provoked, and inspired’, INCOGNITO by Tin Drum Theater is definitely for you!
On a positive note, this sterling production of a flawed play announces to the theatergoing public that Tin Drum—which was launched only last year—is a company worth watching.
It’s the type of work that makes live theater so in-the-moment absorbing and exhilarating.

cn.t: Critics praise Nick Payne's intellectually ambitious "Incognito" for its inventive nonlinear storytelling and philosophical depth. The production earns acclaim for superb performances and masterful direction that brings complex explorations of memory and identity to life.
